canonical_question: Is the assumed bulk substrate composition of Cr 17.5 Fe 27.5 Mn 27.5 Ni 27.5 representative of the actual bulk alloy after homogenization?

question_variants.question: Is the assumed bulk substrate composition of Cr 17.5 Fe 27.5 Mn 27.5 Ni 27.5 representative of the actual bulk alloy after homogenization?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The simulation uses the specified bulk composition, but the evidence does not confirm if the actual homogenized bulk alloy matches this exact composition.

answers.answer: The diffusion configuration assumes a bulk substrate of Cr 17.5 Fe 27.5 Mn 27.5 Ni 27.5, but the text does not provide evidence confirming this exact match to the actual homogenized bulk alloy composition (nominal Cr 18 Mn 27 Fe 27.5 Ni 27.5).
answers.boundary_limitation: Discrepancy between nominal alloy (18% Cr) and simulation input (17.5% Cr) is noted but actual homogenized composition verification is not in evidence.
evidence_spans: In order to confirm the above findings, CALPHAD calculations were performed to determine all the equilibrium phases for the Cr 18 Mn 27 Fe 27.5 Ni 27.5 alloy.
At 700 °C, the alloy is expected to contain both FCC and BCC phases.
The BCC phase is approximately 4% in phase fraction and is rich in Cr and low in Ni with nominal composition of Cr 67 Fe 13 Mn 18.5 Ni 1.5 .
